# Bibliography

References are managed in `references.bib` (BibTeX, exportable from Zotero via Better BibTeX) and formatted here in APA style using `apa.csl`. Every entry in that file is listed below regardless of whether it is cited inline elsewhere in the document (via the `nocite: '@*'` option in [1_master.qmd](1_master.qmd)). To cite a source inline in another chapter, use Pandoc's citation syntax, e.g. `[@buns1991]` or `Büns and Ratte [-@buns1991]`.

::: {#refs}
